name: Ballycarrigeen Upper
address: Ballycarrigeen Upper, Ferns (Boolavogue), Enniscorthy, Co. Wexford
questions: There's no floor plan or floor area. What is the floor area on the BER certificate, and what are the exact BER band (C1, C2 or C3) and kWh/m²/yr figure? Can you send a floor plan?
Is the bathroom with the bath (3.67 × 1.94 m) on the ground floor, beside the playroom? Could the playroom work as a ground-floor bedroom for my parents, and how steep is the stairs?
Can you send a site map of the 0.75 acres? Is the whole boundary, front and back, fenced and gated well enough to keep two dogs in? And who owns the overhead line that crosses the back garden?
How old are the well and septic tank? Is there a recent water test, and is the tank registered and inspected?
Has the house been tested for radon? BuyerIQ flags one critical finding and an active build within 1 km. What is being built nearby, and is the M11 (about 700 m away) audible from the garden?

ai.why: Immaculate dormer on a lovely gated 0.75 ac garden, but tight for six: the ground-floor bedroom means giving up the playroom, which shrinks the common rooms, and upstairs has only a shower room.

electricity.detail: Connected; not stated, but the house is lived in and a supply line crosses the garden.

water.detail: Private well; the listing's services say 'Well water'. Ask for a recent water test.

sewer.detail: Septic tank, per the listing's services. Ask its age, and whether it's registered and has been inspected.

internet.detail: Fibre likely; the listing says nothing, but BuyerIQ lists 'Fast broadband: 102 Mb full fibre' in its favour (its own broadband panel shows no data). NBI has built across north Wexford (Ballycarney and Ferns areas). Confirm on nbi.ie by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: No bedroom downstairs today; the playroom (3.91 × 3.67 m, dual aspect, bay window) could become one, and the bathroom with a bath (3.67 × 1.94 m) looks to be on the same floor.

type: Detached dormer bungalow (storey and a half)
bedsNote: All four bedrooms are upstairs in the dormer; bedroom 4 (2.57 × 2.53 m) is plumbed to go back to being a bathroom. The ground-floor playroom could serve as a fifth bedroom.
heating: Oil-fired central heating; wood-burning stove in the living room
tagline: An immaculate four-bed dormer bungalow on 0.75 acres of enclosed, mature, south-facing garden, about 1.6 km from Boolavogue and 5 km from Ferns in north Wexford.

pros.detail: A mature, south-facing rear garden of about 0.75 ac (0.30 ha), described as fully enclosed and gated, with lawn, an apple orchard, a stand of native trees, a concreted basketball court, metal and timber sheds and a polytunnel.

Hand-painted solid-oak kitchen with oiled oak tops, a Belfast sink and a Rangemaster gas range in a brick surround; bay windows in the living room and playroom, a wood-burning stove, and views of Sliabh Bhuí from the landing. The listing calls it 'immaculately presented'.

pros.text: A room to convert, with a bathroom beside it
pros.detail: The playroom (3.91 × 3.67 m, dual aspect) could become a bedroom for Gabor's parents; the bathroom with a bath and Triton shower (3.67 × 1.94 m) is listed among the ground-floor rooms and has a flat ceiling in the photos.
About €3,330/m² on the estimated 135 m²; stamp duty about €4,500.

pros.text: Set back from a quiet road, no close farmyards
pros.detail: Esri imagery puts the house about 30 m back from the L1024 Ballymore Road (60 km/h) behind its front lawn; the nearest farm buildings are about 260 m south-east, with bigger yards 350–500 m north. Neighbouring houses sit about 35 m to the west and north-east.
Boolavogue NS (mixed, 90 pupils) is 1.6 km; Ferns Health Centre and the Ferns Centra are about 5 km, and Enniscorthy is 13 km.

cons.detail: All four bedrooms are upstairs; housing the parents downstairs means giving up the playroom, the only reception room besides the living room and the kitchen/dining room.
The bedrooms are 10.3, 9.0, 9.4 and 6.5 m² under sloping dormer ceilings, and the upstairs shower room is 1.78 × 1.44 m. It works for six, but snugly.

cons.text: Dublin train is a drive and about 2 hours
cons.detail: Enniscorthy station is about 13 km by road (Gorey about 17 km); 5 Dublin trains each weekday, about 1h50–2h20 to Connolly.
Wexford General (all ages, per HSE) is about 26 km as the crow flies, roughly 32 km by road.

cons.text: Oil heating, BER C, well and septic
cons.detail: Oil-fired central heating with a stove; BER C with no kWh figure published; private well and septic tank, so budget for a water test and tank check.

cons.text: No floor plan; floor area is an estimate
cons.detail: Neither Daft nor MyHome has a plan or a floor area. The measured rooms add up to 113 m²; adding the unmeasured hall, stairs, landing and hot press gives about 135 m², which fits the 12–13 × 8–9 m roof seen from above.

cons.text: Overhead line, M11 and unread risk findings
cons.detail: A supply line crosses the back garden; the M11 Ferns bypass is about 700 m north-west (BuyerIQ says the house is outside mapped noise zones); BuyerIQ's paywalled report has one critical and four high-priority findings (fix range €800–2,000) and seven planning applications within 1 km, one an active build.

trips.label: School run
trips.title: Boolavogue National School
candidates: Boolavogue National School, Boolavogue, Ferns, Co. Wexford
trips.note: Catholic, mixed (48 boys, 42 girls), not DEIS, roll 18336J; 1.6 km per Daft. Enrolment has fallen from about 119 in 2021 to 90.

rating.basis: Mixed, non-DEIS rural school of 90 pupils with falling enrolment; no inspection report could be read because gov.ie's report pages sit behind a human check.

trips.title: St Edan's National School, Ferns
candidates: St Edan's National School, Clone Road, Ferns, Co. Wexford
trips.note: Church of Ireland, mixed, about 30 pupils, roll 18714P; 4.4 km per Daft. It may prioritise its own families if full. Naomh Maodhog NS in Ferns (about 300 pupils) is 5 km.

rating.basis: A 2016 Department curriculum evaluation (Visual Arts) rated pupils' learning and teaching very good; it covers one subject and is ten years old.

trips.title: Enniscorthy Community College

trips.note: Mixed WWETB school, about 470–490 pupils; 11.8 km per Daft. St Mary's CBS (boys, about 770) is the same distance; Coláiste Bríde, the nearest at 10.9 km, is girls-only.

rating.basis: DEIS per scoilscout and enrolment up since 2019; no progression figure or inspection report could be retrieved.

trips.title: Gorey Community School

rating.basis: Ireland's largest school (about 1,540, mixed, free) with wide subject choice and a long good reputation; no recent progression figure retrieved, so moderate confidence.
